units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905
author: Aoki
notes: Credit and a spawn, and no start or finish, on purpose (gb-maps-1): an adventure climb map whose progress is buttons, levers, timed doors and a minecart (16 buttons, 13 func_wall_toggle, 12 logic_timer), with 79 joke-named destinations and no labelled start or finish. Its players spawn over an intro room and drop 800 units into it; the button there (finbut1) triggers `mapstartodesu`, which opens the room and 25 s later enables the teleport to `map0stato`, the start of the map proper. This game runs none of that, so the spawn here is `map0stato` itself. Nothing in the file marks where the map ends, and a finish line guessed from the logic is a board measuring a route the map does not have. Loads, draws and collides; zones want drawing in-game with the zone editor. Not published.
